column1: # REQ-023 per-matrix LR intervention analysis. SHA 25d3208.
# Response: log(lambda_top) [raw] and log(lambda_top*||W||_F^2) [gauge] at LATE checkpoint (f1500=2250, f2000=2750).
# beta = direct own-multiplier slope, WITHIN-MATRIX (matrix fixed effects) regression on x=log(own multiplier).
#   Interpretation: response ~ beta * log(multiplier); EoS predicts beta<0 (higher LR -> lower curvature).
# cross_<group> = slope of the within-matrix residual (own-multiplier removed) on the mean log-multiplier of that neighbor group.
#   LOCAL law -> cross ~ 0; COLLECTIVE redistribution -> cross systematically != 0.
# n=3 assignments is the replication unit; SEs are approximate (few clusters). Discovery experiment, NOT a significance claim.
# CHECKPOINT-GRID CAVEAT: frozen config dumped step%125==0 -> late ckpt used is {2250,2750}, NOT the request's {2350,2850}
#   (checkpoint_model_at_cadence every:125; step_is_due fires at step%125==0 or train_steps-1=3249, never reached).
